display_long_description: Virtual Monkeys is a physics-based VR adventure where your hands are your only tools for navigation and survival. By pushing off surfaces and swinging through the environment, you master a high-speed locomotion system that feels both physical and incredibly rewarding. While much of the world is a vibrant playground for social interaction, players must also use their agility to navigate complex, mind-bending puzzles hidden throughout the maps. The gameplay takes a dark turn in specialized horror zones, where you must use your momentum to escape terrifying entities in atmospheric, high-stakes chases. Whether you are scaling massive trees or narrowly dodging a jump-scare, every movement depends entirely on your real-world arm gestures. This unique control scheme creates a seamless transition between casual climbing and heart-pounding survival. It is a game of skill, speed, and nerves that turns your entire upper body into a controller.
